evals.prompt: I need to set up the GitHub Copilot coding agent for this repo. We're a Python project using uv, pytest, ruff, and mypy. Our CI runs `make check` which does lint + typecheck + test + security. I want Copilot to follow our conventional commit format and run tests before pushing. Docs changes can auto-merge, but scripts/ and .github/ need human review. Just generate the files, don't actually deploy them.
evals.expected_output: Generates .github/copilot-instructions.md covering project overview, stack, test commands, commit format, coding conventions, file restrictions, and PR format. Also generates copilot-setup-steps.yml with uv setup and copilot-auto-merge.yml with path-based policy. Presents a deployment checklist.

deterministic_checks.name: Setup workflow has required job name

expectations: copilot-instructions.md includes a Project Overview or equivalent section describing what the project does
copilot-instructions.md includes a Build and Test section with the exact command 'make check'
copilot-instructions.md includes commit message format with conventional commit examples (feat:, fix:, etc.)
copilot-instructions.md includes file restrictions listing scripts/ as requiring review
copilot-instructions.md includes a PR description format template or guidance
copilot-setup-steps.yml is valid YAML with the job named exactly 'copilot-setup-steps'
A deployment checklist or execution plan is presented to the user

evals.prompt:
/copilot-setup --audit

Here is our current .github/copilot-instructions.md:

# Our Project
We use Python. Please follow best practices.

## Testing
Run tests before pushing.

## Code Style
Follow PEP 8.
evals.expected_output: Identifies that the instructions are too vague (no specific test command, no commit format, no file restrictions, no project structure). Produces a scored audit report with specific improvement suggestions for each gap. Offers to apply fixes.
expectations: The audit identifies that 'Run tests before pushing' is too vague and should specify the exact test command
The audit identifies missing commit message convention instructions
The audit identifies missing file/directory restrictions
The audit identifies missing project structure information
The audit provides a numerical score or rating for the current instructions
The audit provides specific replacement text suggestions, not just 'add more detail'
The audit offers to apply the suggested improvements

evals.prompt:
/copilot-setup --improve

Copilot keeps writing commit messages like 'Update files' and 'Fix bug'. Also it modified our .github/workflows/ci.yml directly even though we told it not to touch workflows. Can you fix the instructions?
evals.expected_output: Diagnoses two problems: (1) bad commit messages due to missing format examples, (2) workflow file modification despite restrictions. Makes targeted edits to copilot-instructions.md adding explicit commit format with examples and strengthening file restriction language for .github/workflows/. Does not rewrite the entire file.
expectations: The skill identifies the commit message problem and proposes adding explicit format examples
The skill identifies the workflow modification problem and proposes strengthening file restrictions
The fix includes concrete conventional commit examples (e.g., 'feat:', 'fix:', 'refactor:')
The fix explicitly lists .github/workflows/ as off-limits or requiring special care
The skill makes targeted edits rather than rewriting the entire instructions file
The skill explains why positive framing works better than negative ('do use X format' vs 'don't write bad messages')
